text:
maria: Hey — noticed per-model throughput in the console dropped to zero for a bunch of models around 12:05 UTC. Charts are flatlined, but backend metrics look like traffic still coming through. Anyone else seeing this?

alex: Seeing it too. dashboard shows 0 rps for model variants but API logs show normal requests. Could be a label mismatch in the analytics pipeline.

raj: I pulled the raw Prometheus metrics: `redwood_inference_model_requests_total` still increments, but the grafana query used `label_replace` expecting `model_name` label. Recent deploy renamed `model` -> `model_name` yesterday, maybe inverse?

olivia: Confirmed — the ingestion job that builds the per-model rollup uses `labels` config in analytics-worker.yaml. It was still mapping `model` and not the new `model_name`. PR merged in infra about label rename didn't update the analytics config.

maria: Ok that explains it. Can we hotfix the dashboard (override query) so customers see throughput while we patch ingestion?

kyle: Quick mitigation: change grafana panel query to fall back to either label. Example: `sum by (model)(rate(redwood_inference_model_requests_total{model!=""}[1m])) or sum by (model_name)(rate(redwood_inference_model_requests_total{model_name!=""}[1m]))` — not pretty but buys time.

raj: Repro steps I used:
1) curl the API to generate traffic for model `rw-large`
2) check Prometheus: `curl http://prom:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(redwood_inference_model_requests_total[1m])`
3) inspect labels in response, saw `model_name` present and `model` absent.

olivia: I'm pushing a small change to analytics-worker to accept both labels and emit `model_name` in the rollups. Making it conditional so future renames don't break things. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/analytics-worker/pulls/212

deploy-bot: deploy queued — analytics-worker/patch-212 to staging (sha: a1b2c3d)

alex: Thx. Can someone also update the rollout checklist so label renames require a follow-up in analytics and dashboards? This bit is too easy to miss.

maria: +1 — customers pinged support already. I've asked support to include the mitigated dashboard link in replies.

raj: Patch deployed to staging, ran end-to-end: rollup shows per-model throughput again. I'll schedule prod deploy after 15m smoke testing.

deploy-bot: analytics-worker/patch-212 deployed to prod (sha: a1b2c3d) :rocket:

olivia: Prod rollup backfilled and dashboards updated. Leaving fallback query for 48hrs then we remove once stable.

kyle: I'll add the checklist item and create a tiny alert that triggers if metrics lose `model_name` label for >5m.

maria: Great work everyone. Please paste the exact customer-facing text into #support so we can close escalations. :thumbsup:
